provenance.reportingContext: Uploaded original collection manifest; selected-position hashes checked against frozen preflight.
provenance.runIdSource: Matching original manifest and uploaded summary; individual journal records contain no run ID.

method.ridgeScale: mean game-weighted loss; penalty on standardized slopes
method.weighting: each sampled game has unit total weight
method.normalizationThreshold: Conservative reporting policy, not a confidence guarantee or a reason to generate more games automatically.
method.regularizationCaveat: Ridge produces finite exploratory slopes even for some separated outcomes; absence of a perfect-classification flag does not exclude quasi-separation.
method.interpretation: Exploratory outcome-predictive coefficients conditional on this selected dataset and playing policy; not intrinsic or causal piece values.
method.anchorConstraint: beta_queen = 9 * beta_pawn with positive fitted score conversion
method.anchorPenalty: Both original pawn and queen standardized slopes retain their ridge penalties.
method.groupingCaveat: Conditions share a selected position; distinct FENs may still share opening ancestry.

bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional resampling across selected book-position clusters; broader opening ancestry is unknown.

normalized.interpretation: Conditional estimates under the declared model, not intrinsic exchange prices.

warnings: Pawn = 1 and queen = 9 are declared analysis anchors, not measured ratios.
More data can reduce sampling uncertainty without removing selection bias, phase dependence or model assumptions.
Whole selected-position clusters preserve triplets; distinct book positions may share opening ancestry.
Material-stable windows do not prove tactical quietness; sampled games retain unit total weight and draws.
Original pilot and external EPD data are not pooled into this study.

decision.status: Close at 1152 games; usable for rough comparisons in this recorded context.

limits: Manifest executable/source hashes and recorded four-job settings match; hashes are not independent process execution attestation.
Replay and refitting validate recorded behavior and arithmetic, not best-play quality.
Fixed pawn/queen ratios are assumptions; conditional bands are not universal material confidence intervals.
Cumulative checkpoints overlap, and different selected FENs may share broader opening ancestry.
No phase-specific values, best-play guarantees or intrinsic exchange prices are established.
